name: obsidian-task-manager
description: FJG Task Manager monorepo for Obsidian task workspaces and browser capture.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fjg/obsidian-task-manager-plugin && npm run build --workspace @fjg/obsidian-task-clipper && npm run build --workspace @fjg/taskctl && npm run build --workspace @fjg/task-migration && node scripts/sync-plugin-root.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
